I don't think we need another class and code duplication here. Let's do this in inventory for memory type.

I think memory needs its own class because it separate class of property under Type 3 spect and does not fall under inventory properties. We have separate encode/decode and buffer management for this which can managed well with separate class. 

What I have done is I have moved this memory inside inventory so that at high level its can still consider as part of inventory. 
I have also reworked to remove any duplicate code and have util class for managing all the retries. 
Please let me know if you are ok with this.

Do we even need this given we have containing/contained_by? If yes, why and then we would also need to document it.
